name: Girly Pop
about: Your candid phone photos full-bleed, with big bold pastel pink and butter-yellow headlines, a handwritten note beside them, and little iPhone bits (a highlighted line with the Copy bar, message bubbles, task chips, a New Message card). Fun, current and confident. Best for: social media managers, creators, day-in-my-life, lifestyle and small business girls.
imageStyle: candid portrait phone photos of a woman in her real day (mirror selfies, coffee in hand, at a cafe table with a laptop, walking the street, at her desk), warm natural light, soft muted neutrals with cream, beige and denim, a little grain, the face in the upper half with calm room below it for the headline
